source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Official Overture description of Fused mirror query parameters and data host.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Overture documents that the Fused Overture UDF loads GeoParquet hosted by Source Cooperative. The area is supplied with bounds/bbox, building is selected with overture_type=building, and optional release, dataset and column parameters can limit the query.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Current Fused SDK loading, bbox ordering and execution-bound contract.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Fused documents public UDFs as free through fused.load("UDF_Name"), recommends pinning Git commit URLs for production, and accepts bounds as a four-number list ordered [min_x,min_y,max_x,max_y]. The default remote realtime engine has an approximately 120 second time limit.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Current HTTP sharing/token requirement and output endpoint form.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Fused HTTP API endpoints require a shared canvas token in the form fc_<token> and a UDF name, for example udf.ai/fc_<CANVAS_TOKEN>/my_udf.json. Without a shared canvas token, a deterministic anonymous HTTP endpoint for this UDF is not established.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Pinned open-source implementation contract and Source Cooperative path construction.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Pinned Fused UDF source defines bounds, release, theme, overture_type and use_columns. For building it maps theme to buildings, defaults to six parts for releases from 2025-01-22-0, constructs s3://us-west-2.opendata.source.coop/fused/overture/{release}/theme={theme}/type={overture_type}, and calls table_to_tile(bounds,...). The pinned source default release is 2026-04-15-0, not the current official release.
